a.lede: The president offered few details on what his proposed new AI Force would do.
a.title: Trump rejects AI slowdown calls, launches "AI Force" instead

b.lede: The U.S. and China have proposed implementing AI red lines that will not be crossed, as well as a hotline between the two countries to provide rapid communication and opportunities for joint responses to rogue AI actions.
b.title: US and China propose hotline to de-escalate AI threats ahead of Washington summit
